ons_load.area_codes_note: Codes confirmed live on 2026-11-10: SECO, S, NE, N (subsystems). SIN responds for verified load but with ALL values zero (2025-10 and 2026-11) — excluded from collection; sum the subsystems instead. State/regional areas also respond: RJ, SP, MG, ES, PR, SC, RS, PESE, MT, MS, GO, DF, AC, RO, AM. SE and BA do not respond.

ecmwf.params_note: tp=total precipitation, 2t=2 m temperature, ro=runoff (all accumulated since the run start, except 2t). ~0.8 MB per lead time; 15 lead times ≈ 12 MB/day. For wind add 100u/100v (+1.3 MB per lead time); for solar, ssrd (+0.5 MB).
ecmwf.license: ECMWF Open Data, CC-BY-4.0 (attribution required). Retention at the source: ~12 runs.

ccee.datasets_note: Names confirmed in the public catalog on 2026-11-10. The catalog also lists pld_horario_submercado (2023+) and pld_media_mensal. Files are yearly and the URLs (.../content) carry no date.

backfill.merge_note: Daily MERGE: ~1 file/day. Use explicit ranges; the plan shows the volume before downloading.

blocked_sources.ccee_pld: HTTP 403 from the CCEE firewall for the outbound IP on 2026-11-10 (including www.ccee.org.br). Connector ready with ccee.enabled=false; enable it when the network has access. Meanwhile, the ONS half-hourly/weekly CMO is the available reference (hourly PLD = DESSEM CMO clipped to the ANEEL-regulated minimum/maximum PLD; it does not replace the official series).
blocked_sources.era5_ecmwf_gefs_ana: Connectors not enabled in this version. ERA5/ECMWF require a local CDS account and key.

notes: Polling frequencies are project policies, not schedules promised by the sources. The yearly INMET package is checked daily but does not contain new observations every day.
